events.label: The Dvapara Yuga
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: The third age in the Puranic tradition. Dharma is described as half. The Mahabharata tradition sets its great war near the end of this age.

events.label: Hastinapur, Period II
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Excavations at Hastinapur found a settlement with Painted Grey Ware pottery, dated by the archaeologist Lal to these years. The level uses it as its backdrop.

events.label: The Well-Rope at Dawn
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A crowded village well at dawn, with a pulling rope and a slick stone curb. Learn how to stand and how to fall. Help a villager up without dropping the bucket.

events.label: Escape from Hastinapur
events.skill: bare hands: grip-break and safe fall
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: On the eve of the great war you carry a farm villages' grain plea through a crowded lamp bazaar. Free your sleeve without striking anyone. Reach the east gate before dawn.

events.label: Hastinapur Excavation 2021-22
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A recent excavation reports an earlier Painted Grey Ware layer. The date comes from a summary, and the report was not read. It is shown only as reported.

events.label: The Lac-House Lane
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A thatch fire runs along a lane of wooden houses. You wet roofs and guide neighbours through smoke. Nobody is at fault in this version.

events.label: The Peace Embassy
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: In the epic tradition an envoy goes to Hastinapura to plead for peace before the war. Versions differ. No one from it is shown.

events.label: The Ferry at the Sea City
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A sea city on the western coast is said in tradition to have gone under the water. The game makes no claim about any real site. You ferry families' bundles up the high steps.

events.label: The Great War
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: The Mahabharata tradition tells of a war between two branches of a family. The game gives no date for it and shows none of it. It is read about, never played.

events.label: The Water-Bearers' Road
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: After the noise of war, tired people walk a long road at dusk. You carry water and cloth to three resting places. No one is turned away, and this is the keystone of the Dvapara ring.
